lines.text: Jesus entered Jericho, where a very wealthy chief tax collector named Zacchaeus was.
Because he was small, Zacchaeus ran ahead and climbed a fig tree to see Jesus.
Jesus looked up and told Zacchaeus to hurry down because He must stay at his house, and Zacchaeus welcomed Him.
The people grumbled, and Zacchaeus said he gives a tenth of his possessions to the poor.
Jesus said salvation had come to the house, because the Son of Man came to seek and save the lost.
